MEETING NOTES — Hydraulics Return Papers Before the
Review Board
Date: 2026-07-07
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0029 for TEAM-0005; originating desk
coordinator; review board recorder; station records clerk.
Purpose: Arrange the review board's discussion of return
Papers associated with ISSUE-0033. TASK-0088, TASK-0089, and
TASK-0090 remain separate locating references for attached
discussion papers.
Decisions PERSON-0029 will be the named reviewer for this
paperwork discussion. The board appointment is 2026-07-08 at
11:50. The reviewer will consider whether the return request
explains the administrative question being raised again and
identifies the earlier closure-note reference.
Apply the return-note rule: retain the earlier question and
write a separate dated reason for bringing it back. Put the
closure-note reference on its own line so a reader can find
the earlier disposition without mistaking it for the new
reason.
The board recorder will preserve the reviewer name, meeting
date, reason, and resulting administrative action together.
The board's remit is completeness and traceability of the
papers. Task kind labels on attachments do not authorize
technical discussion in these notes.
Action items
- Owner: Originating desk coordinator. Due: 2026-07-08 at
09:30. Bring the original question and dated return reason.
- Owner: Station records clerk. Due: 2026-07-08 at 10:30.
